general.description: New Life was a promising Colony established in the Ventose Planet, if it wasn't managed by the Better Worlds Company. Now its transit station remain empty, its "New Life" panel tagged with a big "No". In the early XXIII century, it has hosted some installations from the dreaded Hopper's Ogres, a branch of the Hopper Connexion, who start to house an Human farm on the abandonned domes in the planetary surface. They where countered by the "Furet" squad and the help of some hired mercenaries, who exfiltred the poors victims of the farm. The derelict station house now sometimes somes squatters, spacer or smugglers in its abandonned halls.
